newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 11.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 11.

text.p: Here are the leading headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon broadcast on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The chairwoman of the parliament's social affairs and labour committee, Birute Visokavichiene, said at a news conference on Friday that bankruptcy laws should be amended to decrease the number of intentional bankruptcies.
- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis said in Washington that the demilitarization of Russia's Kaliningrad enclave is a problem facing all of Europe.
- Lithuania has become a member of the United Nations' Special Peace Keeping Operations Committee.
